fusions.name: Rampart Rush
fusions.desc: You slam the target for 14 damage and stun it for 1 second, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bearing Down
fusions.desc: Hits every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 8 damage to each. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Guarded Stride
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, hardening your armour by 10%.

fusions.name: Taken in Stride
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (48% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10s.
